business_objectives: Convene a panel of discipline-expert AI agents that read a deal and find holes from their own POV
Produce the best-possible deal recommendation: limitations per discipline, mitigants, and explicit deal-breakers
Offer two user-selectable outputs: (A) a synthesized IC memo via acos-axiom-synthesis, (B) a live, interruptible, human-in-the-loop deliberation
Maximize genuine dissent and disciplinary coverage; never rubber-stamp; never fabricate consensus
Reuse existing ACOS engines (axiom-synthesis, legal-analyst) rather than rebuild
primary_users: OKOA associate/analyst acting as IC chair (Zee)
OKOA deal/underwriting team preparing a credit decision
OKOA investment decision-makers who consume the IC memo
top_user_problems_ranked: Single-analyst review structurally misses discipline-specific holes (legal, valuation, environmental, concentration, fraud)
LLM/analyst reviews are sycophantic and drift toward rubber-stamping the deal framing
No structured way to separate deal-breakers from mitigable risks, each with a mitigant + residual-risk statement
No way to run an adversarial, human-participated deliberation like a real IC
Two risks are nobody's job by default: fund-level concentration and financial-statement fraud
feature_config.strategy_context: OKOA Capital is a PE real-estate / private-credit secured lender (deal-by-deal lien positioning, Utah-organized, lends UT/HI/ID/PR+). The IC skill is a thin orchestrator + domain adapter over existing ACOS epistemics engines. Mode A synthesis = acos-axiom-synthesis (refutation-and-grading, preserves conflict, terminates in UNRESOLVED never fabricated consensus). Legal seat = existing legal-analyst via /acos-legal-analysis. Orchestration = Wigum loop + deterministic consensus tally + blind independent dispatch. Independence-first is the primary anti-groupthink lever. The overall verdict is computed deterministically (asymmetric-veto on deal-breakers), not narrated by an LLM.
constraints: Subscription-only Claude: never ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; spawn via Task()
Subagents cannot call AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode -> the Mode B moderator MUST be the top-level SKILL.md (main conversation)
Model diversity limited to Opus/Sonnet class + persona/temperature by default; multi-provider (Hybrid-Review) optional -> emit reduced-independence flag when single-provider
Must run under ACOS hooks (Oracle PreToolUse, check-scope) and the autopilot/eternity continuation system
Deliberation must be honest about turn-based execution (moderated relay, not simulated real-time)
Verdict must never be a fabricated PROCEED or DECLINE; UNRESOLVED is a first-class output
known_dependencies: legal-analyst agent + /acos-legal-analysis skill (legal seat; findings-manifest.yaml, red-flags.yaml)
Model Profile system (resolve-agent-model.sh) for per-seat model-class diversity
Task() + SubagentStart/Stop hooks; deterministic consensus tally pattern (dr2 consensus_check.py)
fin-stmt-accountant 'bounce request up + persist + re-dispatch' idiom for human input
autopilot-active state detection; Eternity Protocol resume (transcript-on-disk survives /clear)
known_risks: Consensus is not evidence of correctness; debate can amplify confident-wrong agents
Sycophancy (~58% baseline) and correlated same-model error (0.396 vs 0.679) undermine independence
autopilot-active silently auto-answers the human-pause AskUserQuestion, defeating HITL
Fund concentration and financial-statement fraud get silent PASS unless explicitly mandated
Cost/latency of 7-9 opus seats x N rounds x two modes
Greenfield UX with no validated precedent for terminal, human-chaired multi-agent financial debate
runtime_guardrails: Independence-first: every seat's opening verdict from an isolated Task() with zero cross-visibility
Never terminate on consensus; hide numeric confidence between agents mid-debate; preserve dissent in the memo
Mandatory falsifiable objection per seat; mandatory pre-mortem round; assigned rotating devil's advocate; consensus-triggered 10th-man escalation
Every non-fatal finding requires a named mitigant + explicit residual-risk; deal-breaker = derived deterministic rule
Asymmetric-veto verdict polarity on deal-breaker-flagged claims; quorum/precedence-ladder otherwise; UNRESOLVED terminal
Detect .acos/state/autopilot-active and refuse deep-pause mode or fall back to documented autonomous batch mode
Per-run conflicts-disclosure.yaml governance artifact (SEC 2026 fiduciary focus)

feature_goals: A discipline-expert agent panel that reads a deal and finds holes per discipline
Mode A: synthesized IC memo (axiom-synthesis) focused on limitations, mitigants, deal-breakers, ending in a deterministic verdict
Mode B: live, interruptible, human-chaired deliberation with stance-tagged turns
Reuse legal-analyst + axiom-synthesis; independence-first; deterministic verdict
user_problems: Discipline-specific holes missed by single-analyst review
No deal-breaker vs mitigable-risk separation with residual risk
Concentration and fraud unowned by default
success_metrics: CQ coverage of the domain lattice >= 95%
Zero uncovered risk category across the seat roster (16-risk coverage map)
Every finding carries severity + mitigant + residual-risk; deal-breakers explicitly flagged
Verdict is deterministic and reproducible from the ledger (never narrated)
Human chair can observe and inject; agents update-with-new-fact or hold-with-reason (no capitulation)
Boss-criticism-proof on first cold look (OKOA final-artifact standard)

domain_focus: Institutional IC / credit-committee governance for PE real-estate & private credit
Multi-agent LLM debate/deliberation (mechanisms, when it helps vs hurts)
Structured hole-finding: pre-mortem, MAP, dialectical inquiry, ACH, reference-class, kill criteria
Synthesis/fusion via acos-axiom-synthesis (objection->claim, severity axis, deterministic verdict)
Human-in-the-loop deliberation UX in a terminal (moderated relay, chair vocabulary)
RE-PE legal/regulatory/fiduciary diligence and reuse of legal-analyst
required_cqs: What disciplines constitute a complete IC panel with zero uncovered risk category?
How is the deal advocate kept structurally independent of the adversarial credit seat?
How do we elicit genuine dissent and avoid sycophancy / correlated same-model error?
How is a live, interruptible, human-chaired deliberation realized on Claude Code primitives?
How does an expert objection map onto an axiom-synthesis atomic claim + a severity axis?
How is the overall PROCEED/DECLINE verdict computed deterministically without fabricating consensus?
What is the canonical IC-memo structure and the Risk->Mitigant->Residual->CP pattern?
Which legal/compliance checks are deal-breakers vs curable-by-condition, and what does legal-analyst already cover?
How does the human chair observe and inject, and how do agents value human input without capitulating?
How is concentration risk (fund-scoped) and financial-statement fraud explicitly owned?
What guardrail handles autopilot-active silently auto-answering the human pause?
How is the deliberation state persisted so it survives /clear and Eternity resume?
evidence_requirements: Cite the swarm synthesis report and the 10 agent findings as the primary evidence ledger
Tier external sources (T1 authoritative regulator/standard, T2 expert, T3 empirical/academic, T4 community, T5 internal ACOS)
Ground every architecture claim in an existing ACOS asset where one exists (axiom-synthesis, legal-analyst, dr2, grader, fin-stmt)

architecture_constraints: Top-level SKILL.md is the Mode B moderator (main conversation); no nested agent owns the human-pausing loop
Append-only transcript files on disk are the source of truth; deterministic tally script for mechanical checks
Reuse acos-axiom-synthesis for Mode A; reuse legal-analyst for the legal seat
Per-seat model-class diversity via the Model Profile system; reduced-independence flag when single-provider
Independence-first blind opening pass in both modes; bounded rounds with a hard cap
Detect autopilot-active; safe (Recommended) pause option under auto-pick
technical_requirements: Seat roster: 7 core + Chair/Gap-Hunter + deal-triggered optionals; advocate separate from adversarial credit; Portfolio seat fund-scoped with loan-tape access
Objection schema with Axis S (severity/materiality) orthogonal to truth-grading
Deterministic verdict via resolve.py polarity (asymmetric-veto on deal-breakers)
Mode B turn schema {round, seat, stance SUPPORT/REBUT/ABSTAIN, argument, addresses_prior_turn_ids, would_change_mind_if}
Human injection as a first-class HUMAN transcript turn; next speaker must address it
conflicts-disclosure.yaml governance artifact per run; compliance companion for usury/AML/foreclosure/Phase I

epic_breakdown: EPIC-A Seat roster + expert-agent definitions + coverage map
EPIC-B Deal intake + independence-first blind opening pass
EPIC-C Mode A synthesis (axiom-synthesis adapter + severity axis + deterministic verdict + IC memo render)
EPIC-D Mode B live deliberation (main-conversation moderator, transcript, chair vocabulary, tally, HITL)

tasks.slice_strategy: Vertical slices delivering demo-able increments: start with a minimal Mode A on a small seat set (walking skeleton), then add seats, then the deterministic verdict, then Mode B moderator loop, then legal reuse, then guardrails/governance. Each slice produces an observable artifact (a memo, a transcript, a verdict file).
priority_order: Walking skeleton: 3-seat Mode A producing a memo (Demo 1)
Full 7-seat roster + severity axis + deterministic verdict (Demo 2)
Mode B moderator loop + transcript + chair vocabulary + HITL (Demo 3)
Guardrails: independence enforcement, kill criteria, autopilot detection, anti-sycophancy
